guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「離子遷移、極化與淡濃水收支」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow ion transport, polarization and dilute/concentrate balances through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「定義除鹽負荷」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只比較導電度會掩蓋流量增加造成的鹽負荷上升。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「電荷與離子當量」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.335803 mol-equivalent，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把二價離子當成一價會低估所需電荷。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「膜面積與電流密度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 40 A/m2，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用膜外框面積會把電流密度估得過低。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「濃差極化餘裕」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.333333 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以清水的極限值套用高污染進水，可能忽略結垢與流道阻塞。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「堆疊電阻與電耗」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.222222 kWh/m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把瓦特直接當千瓦時每立方公尺會錯用時間與流量單位。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「水回收率與濃水」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 2.5 m3/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報回收率可能隱藏濃水量減少後的結垢風險。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「淡濃水鹽平衡」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3.4 kg/m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「非同步樣品在進水變動時會造成假的失衡。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「結垢趨勢與反轉」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3.4 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把濃縮倍率直接當溶解度安全係數會漏掉離子活度效應。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「流道泵浦功率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 153.846 W，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「泵效率和堆效率混為一談會低估總耗電。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「產品異常的聯鎖證據」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.0416667 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「忽略延遲會把警報之前的產水當作已驗證。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for define the desalination load, first reproduce 30 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Conductivity alone hides a salt-load increase caused by higher flow." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for charge and ionic equivalents, first reproduce 0.335803 mol-equivalent, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating divalent ions as monovalent underestimates charge demand." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for membrane area and current density, first reproduce 40 A/m2, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using the frame area understates current density." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for concentration-polarization margin, first reproduce 0.333333 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Applying a clean-water limit to fouling feed ignores scaling and channel obstruction." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for stack resistance and energy, first reproduce 0.222222 kWh/m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating watts as kWh per cubic metre mixes time and flow units." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for water recovery and concentrate, first reproduce 2.5 m3/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Recovery alone hides scaling risk as concentrate volume falls." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for dilute-concentrate salt balance, first reproduce 3.4 kg/m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Asynchronous samples create a false imbalance during feed changes." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for scaling trends and reversal, first reproduce 3.4 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using concentration factor as a solubility safety factor misses activity effects." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for channel pumping power, first reproduce 153.846 W, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Confusing pump and stack efficiencies understates total electricity." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for evidence for product-quality interlocks, first reproduce 0.0416667 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Ignoring delay treats pre-alarm product as verified." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 改變流量而固定鹽濃度，核對質量流率斜率。
改變電流並量測淡濃水離子收支，以反算效率。
把有效面積減少10%，繪出平均電流密度變化。
比較兩種流速的電流—電壓曲線，找出平台轉折。
保持產水量，增加電阻並比較電壓和比電耗。
把產水量由7.5改成8，重算濃水與鹽濃度。
同時抽取三股流並保留取樣時刻。
比較反轉前後壓差和電阻，區分流道阻塞與膜污染。
把流量加倍，另行量測壓差而非假設不變。
注入假想感測延遲並追蹤受影響水量。
evidenceEn: Vary flow at fixed salinity and check the mass-rate slope.
Vary current and use dilute/concentrate ionic balances to infer efficiency.
Reduce active area by ten percent and plot mean current density.
Compare current-voltage curves at two flow velocities and locate the plateau transition.
Hold production fixed, increase resistance, and compare voltage and specific energy.
Raise product flow from7.5 to8 and recalculate concentrate flow and salinity.
Sample all three streams synchronously and retain timestamps.
Compare pressure drop and resistance before/after reversal to distinguish channel blockage from membrane fouling.
Double flow and measure pressure drop rather than assuming it stays fixed.
Inject a hypothetical sensor delay and track the affected volume.
pitfalls: 只比較導電度會掩蓋流量增加造成的鹽負荷上升。
把二價離子當成一價會低估所需電荷。
用膜外框面積會把電流密度估得過低。
以清水的極限值套用高污染進水，可能忽略結垢與流道阻塞。
把瓦特直接當千瓦時每立方公尺會錯用時間與流量單位。
只報回收率可能隱藏濃水量減少後的結垢風險。
非同步樣品在進水變動時會造成假的失衡。
把濃縮倍率直接當溶解度安全係數會漏掉離子活度效應。
泵效率和堆效率混為一談會低估總耗電。
忽略延遲會把警報之前的產水當作已驗證。
pitfallsEn: Conductivity alone hides a salt-load increase caused by higher flow.
Treating divalent ions as monovalent underestimates charge demand.
Using the frame area understates current density.
Applying a clean-water limit to fouling feed ignores scaling and channel obstruction.
Treating watts as kWh per cubic metre mixes time and flow units.
Recovery alone hides scaling risk as concentrate volume falls.
Asynchronous samples create a false imbalance during feed changes.
Using concentration factor as a solubility safety factor misses activity effects.
Confusing pump and stack efficiencies understates total electricity.
Ignoring delay treats pre-alarm product as verified.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
